title: An ATM/Chk2-mediated DNA damage-responsive signaling pathway suppresses Epstein-Barr virus transformation of primary human B cells

grounded.evidence_quote: Signaling downstream of oncogenic stress involves activation of the single-stranded DNA-dependent ATR pathway and the double-stranded break-induced ATM pathway.
Signaling downstream of oncogenic stress involves activation of the single-stranded DNA-dependent ATR pathway and the double-stranded break-induced ATM pathway.

grounded.context: replication intermediates of DNA viruses and retroviruses
grounded.evidence_quote: In addition to oncogenic stress, replication intermediates of DNA viruses and retroviruses contain double-stranded DNA ends that activate ATM (Lilley et al., 2007).
